reason: Driven at 1440 on notes.notebook, two of these are objectively broken, not taste: pressing the head's "Private to you" announces into the live region, verbatim, "Yours until you send something on Your privacy settings are on another screen." — two sentences fused, because N.copy.privacyLong (src/fixture.js:617) has no terminal period and src/notes.js:3465 omits the one that lines 1632 and 2656 both add; and pressing the note's "More actions for this note" announces "The rest of Signal Studio is on another screen.", the wrong destination and with no "Not here yet." at all. src/notes.js is the only file in src/ containing "another screen" (11 occurrences) against the ratified noun-phrase grammar at src/app.js:96-105, and the door titles contradict themselves in one breath — "happens on another screen. Not here yet." cannot both be true.
sharpenedFix: Correct two errors in the proposed fix first. (a) ELSEWHERE.photo and ELSEWHERE.options are DEAD code: src/notes.js:3220 intercepts any aria-disabled control whose title matches /Not here yet/ and announces the TITLE — driven, [data-act="options"] and [data-act="photo"] speak their titles verbatim and never reach the table. So rewrite the titles at 1633/1675/1698/1800 and delete those two table entries rather than rewriting them. (b) ELSEWHERE.more is reached ONLY by the note-level button at src/notes.js:1951/2200, whose own aria-label is "More actions for this note" — the suite door is handled separately at src/notes.js:3243 — so it must become "More for this note. Not here yet.", NOT "The rest of Signal Studio. Not here yet." as proposed, which would keep the exact mismatch that makes it a defect. Then: titles 1633 -> "More for this note. Not here yet."; 1675/1698/1800 -> "A photo, read into words. Not here yet."; ELSEWHERE.privacy -> `${N.copy.privacyLong}. Your privacy settings. Not here yet.` (the period is the bug); retry -> "Sending again. Not here yet. Your note is still here."; destroy -> "Deleting for good. Not here yet. Nothing here is deleted.". Gate it: assert every string a closed door speaks ends in "Not here yet." (optionally plus one reassurance sentence) and that no string in src/ contains "another screen".
